component.name: Glint
Glint 截图
component.summary: Instant screenshots, annotation and pinning for GNOME
GNOME 上的即时截图、标注与贴图

description.p: Glint captures from inside GNOME Shell the moment you press F1, so there is no start-up delay and open menus, popups and tooltips stay in the shot.
Glint 在按下 F1 的瞬间从 GNOME Shell 内部截取画面，没有启动延迟，打开的菜单、弹窗和提示都能截到。

ul.li: Window, menu and panel auto-detection with a pixel loupe and colour picker
Rectangle, ellipse, arrow, line, pen, marker, text, mosaic and step markers
Pin captures or clipboard contents on top of every window; zoom and fade them

description.p: Introduce an orange crop-frame G icon and warm orange selection controls. Add author email, mail launch and copy actions to preferences.

Install required dependencies automatically with the bundled installer. Start capturing immediately after installation through the system screenshot portal, with temporary shortcuts until the GNOME extension loads.
Fix pasting screenshots into other applications, speed up high-resolution capture with parallel lossless encoding, and center the indicator menu.
Snipaste-style selection frame: drag anywhere outside the selection to move its nearest edges, keep adjusting it while annotating, and fine-tune it from the keyboard.
